text: この　はやしは　きんじょの　トレーナーが　れんしゅうに　くる　ばしょさ！

structure.jp: きんじょの　トレーナーが　れんしゅうに　くる
structure.en: where local Trainers come to practice

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: きんじょの　トレーナーが　れんしゅうに　くる　ばしょ
patterns.explanation: A whole phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes it, like 'where...' in English. トレーナーが　れんしゅうに　くる　ばしょ = 'a place where Trainers come to practice'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: れんしゅうに　くる
patterns.explanation: に before a verb of coming or going shows what you come to do. れんしゅうに　くる = 'come to practice'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: さ at the end is a casual, breezy way to state something, used in place of だ, mostly by boys and men. ばしょさ = 'it's the place, you know'.
